ns2:course.label: ACES Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: Provides campus credit in the College of Agricultural, Consumer and Environmental Sciences for study at accredited foreign institutions. Final determination of credit granted is made upon the student's successful completion of work. (Summer session) 0 to 8 undergraduate hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 36 hours within one calendar year. Prerequisite: Consent of major department, college, and Study Abroad Office.
